title: Ecclesiam tuam Deus (Bologna Q19) (Jachet)
desc: Jachet of Mantua, Ecclesiam tuam Deus (Bologna Q19). 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Bologna Q19. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
